articles.summary: Vote.org CEO Andrea Hailey issued the following statement in response to President Trump's address last night making unsubstantiated claims of widespread voter fraud and election vulnerabilities.
articles.title: Vote.org Condemns Trump's Dangerous, Baseless Voter Fraud Claims

articles.summary: Vote.org, the nation’s largest nonpartisan, nonproﬁt voter registration and engagement platform, today announced record-breaking voter registration in the ﬁrst half of 2026. As of June 30, 230,430 voters had used Vote.org’s tools this year to register to vote – the most the organization has ever recorded at the midpoint of a midterm year, and more than double the 94,222 registered by this point in 2022, the last comparable midterm year.
articles.title: Vote.org Sees Record Breaking Voter Registration Through First Six Months of 2026
